draft.subject: Robotics Electrical Engineering Intern | Justin Mascarenhas
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I applied for the Robotics Electrical Engineering Intern role at RoboForce and wanted to reach out directly, since building Physical AI robots for real industrial deployment is exactly the kind of hands on engineering problem I want to work on.

My background is hands on embedded work across STM32 microcontrollers, Arduino, and custom PCB fabrication, along with hands on lab experience debugging with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. I have spent most of my projects bridging hardware and firmware, which lines up closely with what this internship asks for.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
